summary.text: Danny Diggs is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia for District 24, serving since 2024. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Local Government, Privileges and Elections, and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: J.D. "Danny" Diggs was born in Hampton, Virginia, on July 6, 1957, according to the Senate's member page.
The page says he earned an associate degree from Thomas Nelson Community College and lists his occupation as retired.

The page lists his memberships as including the Virginia Sheriffs' Association (president), the York County Chamber of Commerce, and chairmanships of the Virginia Peninsula Regional Jail and the Hampton Roads Criminal Justice Training Academy.
